'''Gyirmót FC Győr''' is a [[Hungary|Hungarian]] football club based in Gyirmót {{IPA|hu|ˈɟirmoːt|}}, a suburb of [[Győr]]. The team currently plays in the second division ([[Nemzeti Bajnokság II]]) of the Hungarian championship.<ref>{{Cite web|title=NB I 2021/2022 - Teams|url=https://www.worldfootball.net/competition/co76/se39445/teams/|access-date=2021-10-27|website=worldfootball.net|language=en}}</ref>"}}
